image.alt: A drawing, made for this course, based on a decorated box from Sumer: three rows of figures in shell and coloured stone on a dark background.

top.alt: Top row of the drawing: seated people drinking from cups at a feast.

middle.alt: Middle row of the drawing: men leading sheep, goats and cattle.

bottom.alt: Bottom row of the drawing: four-wheeled carts pulled by animals, with soldiers on foot.

ornament.alt: Close view of the drawing, showing the detail of the patterned clothes and ornaments.
